title: Baby Crab
hook: 小螃蟹被渔网缠住了，Dora 帮它找妈妈，一路走过沙堡和满是贝壳的沙滩。

cells.en: Dora gets the baby crab out of the fishing net.
cells.cn: Dora 把小螃蟹从渔网里救了出来。

cells.en: They shake their bodies and sing “Menea te”.
cells.cn: 他们一边扭扭身子，一边唱“动起来”。

cells.en: Map says: castle, clams, then Crab Island.
cells.cn: 地图说：沙堡、蛤蜊，然后到螃蟹岛。

cells.en: The little crab snaps its claws on the sand.
cells.cn: 小螃蟹在沙地上“咔哒咔哒”地夹钳子。

cells.en: Dora steps in the wet sand. “That was squishy!”
cells.cn: Dora 踩进湿沙子，“软软的，好奇怪！”

cells.en: They walk past many sandcastles on the beach.
cells.cn: 他们走过沙滩上一座座沙堡。

cells.en: There are shells, stars and crabs on the sand.
cells.cn: 沙滩上有贝壳、海星，还有螃蟹。

cells.en: Map says, “Crab Island, right!” and checks the way.
cells.cn: 地图说：“螃蟹岛，对啦！”然后把路打勾。

cells.en: The baby crab gives mommy a pearl necklace.
cells.cn: 小螃蟹送给妈妈一串珍珠项链。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baby Crab”.
ending: In the end, the baby crab finds its mommy on Crab Island. My favorite part is ______.
